correctness.rationale: For independent equal-rate Poisson components on jumps 1,...,k, h_{k,n}(t)=[z^n]exp(t sum_j z^j) has the exact Panjer derivative recurrence. Any global mode m satisfies m<=t*k(k+1)/2, so t<=2 reduces to 0<=m<=k(k+1). Reconstructed factorial-normalized integer polynomials and 109,943 triple difference gcds modulo prime 1000003; all had gcd 1 except (1,3,4) for k=4..8 with gcd t+6, and the exact characteristic-zero shared root there is -6. Leading coefficients are units modulo p, hence any positive-characteristic-zero common factor would reduce nontrivially: modular gcd exclusion is rigorous, not floating point. For t>2, Q uniform on jumps 1..k, total Poisson jump rate kt, Q#(j) proportional to j+1 strictly log-concave and (kt)*Q(1)^2>2Q(2); Hansen/JKM gives strict log concavity, preventing three maxima. Endpoints t=2 and mode zero included. The independent checker rebuilt polynomials/gcds from exact coefficient recurrence, with 35+286+1330+4495+12341+29260+62196=109943 triple tests.
